text:
maria: Heads up — deploybot skipped a publish for go-service:staging due to an ambiguous digest suffix. saw this in the logs:

```: ERROR publish - ambiguous digest "sha256:8f9a3..." matched multiple tag candidates (staging, staging-20260321). Action: skipped.
```

deploybot: @maria publish skipped for go-service:staging (reason: ambiguous digest match). job id job-788.

sam: ok — did CI republish the same manifest twice or did tagging race?

maria: CI ran twice for the same PR (20260321). build ids 20260321.1 and 20260321.2 produced identical manifest digests, but tag assignment overlapped so staging ended up pointing at the older build id in the registry index. canary looks correct.

kevin: would prefer manual promote -> pin to digest rather than retagging the old tag (avoids churn).

elaine: +1. manual promote the intended digest (the newer build) and then pin staging to that sha. also suggest disabling auto-promote for the release window for 30m to avoid another race.

sam: what are the exact steps?

maria: plan: 1) promote the digest we want to staging, 2) apply a pin so staging is immutable, 3) add a short release-note entry, 4) temporarily disable auto-promote for 30m. I'll run the promote. commands I will use:

```
# promote
deploybot promote --image go-service@sha256:8f9a3b7c... --target staging --by maria
# pin
deploybot pin --target staging --image go-service --digest sha256:8f9a3b7c...
```

deploybot: Promote request accepted (job-789). ETA ~45s. Notifying registry.

deploybot: Promote job-789 completed — staging now points to go-service@sha256:8f9a3b7c... Pin applied.

elaine: I'll add to release notes: "go-service: staging pinned to build 20260321.2 (sha256:8f9a3b7c...) to resolve tag race" and post in #release-notes. emailing CS about the short blip.

kevin: disabled auto-promote in the release window for 30m (config flag: releases.auto_promote=false). will re-enable after monitor window.

maria: Monitoring registry pulls and canary metrics for 15m. If anyone sees 404s or checksum mismatches, tag me or ping #eng-oncall.

ops-oncall: saw ~4 client 404s within the last 10m, all cleared after the promote. will keep an eye. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — closing this thread. we'll follow up in changelog entry for the deploybot to add a guard for simultaneous tag assignments.
